decisions.why: D3 DFA (direct fluorescent antibody) respiratory virus screening/ID kits are lab-run reagent kits, not bedside tests — laboratory consumables, checked against the product list on record
ready-to-use cell culture products for viral isolation — laboratory consumables
Lyra molecular (PCR) assay kits for infectious disease targets — lab-run reagent kits, laboratory consumables
Microvue EIA (enzyme immunoassay) test kits — lab-run reagent kits, laboratory consumables
QuickVue rapid lateral-flow tests (Strep A, hCG, H. pylori, adenoviral conjunctivitis) are bedside/near-patient rapid tests — point of care testing
ready-to-use cell cultures for rapid virus isolation — laboratory consumables

the division's own evidence spans both: 'Sofia 2 Instrument' is the fluorescent immunoassay reader (equipment), while the FIA cassette tests (Influenza, RSV, Strep A, SARS antigen) are CLIA-waived near-patient rapid tests run on it (point of care)

the division's own evidence spans both: 'Solana Instrument' is the analyser (equipment), while the named assays and control sets (C. difficile, GBS, HSV, influenza, RSV/hMPV, SARS-CoV-2) are lab-run molecular reagent kits (laboratory consumables)

the division's own evidence spans both: 'Savanna Instrument' is the analyser (equipment), while the respiratory viral panel and HSV/VZV assay are lab-run molecular reagent kits (laboratory consumables)
Thyretain TBI/TSI reporter bioassay kits are lab-run reagent kits — laboratory consumables

Triage MeterPro cardiac marker panels (D-Dimer, NT-proBNP, cardiac panel) are near-patient/ED bedside tests run on the Triage analyser — point of care testing, consistent with Radiometer UK's 'Immunoassay Testing' precedent
pre-analytical/automation accessories for the Vitros platform (tube entry, rack loader, centrifuge, decapper, aliquoter/labeler) — laboratory analyser/automation equipment
